why: The one structural difference between an overlay and a route (`navigation.ts`): a route may never be pushed over an overlay. Dropping the check lets `openLayer`'s replace rule pop the unanswered confirmation and open a pane over the surface it was blocking -- which is the outcome `push` would have refused, except that the pop happens first. The player's Back then lands on a screen they never asked for, with the destructive question silently withdrawn.
killedBy: hud: the replace-run confirmation (issue #226) is a BLOCKING layer: no route opens under an unanswered question
